trustedTenant: every query/command carries positive tenantId and must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before platform idempotency, locks or business reads; mismatch is TENANT_CONTEXT_MISMATCH
initiatorRule: start resolves the trusted current user from the enclosing F-CUT-004 submit transaction, locks ProjectScopeApi ACTION_EDIT for the task project, and freezes userId/projectId/ACTION_EDIT/treeVersion as the real first INITIATOR node; P4 submit never auto-approves that node

exactFields.checklistId: positive Long|null; required for A/B/C and null for D
exactFields.checklistVersion: positive Integer|null; required for A/B/C and null for D
exactFields.planSubmittedAt: required LocalDateTime; trusted server time allocated once by the enclosing P4 submit transaction and persisted unchanged to the plan revision after approval start succeeds
exactFields.previousApprovalInstanceId: positive Long|null; allowed only when the previous fact is REJECTED or PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED

exactFields.fact: CutoverApprovalFact|null; required for FOUND and null for NOT_FOUND

start.transaction: MANDATORY; joins F-CUT-004 submission; locks the task/assessment/checklist/plan roots and initiator ACTION_EDIT fact, accepts the enclosing transaction's single trusted planSubmittedAt, assembles the exact immutable F-CUT-005 ApprovalSourceSnapshot from locked CUT facts, creates one PENDING approval and returns its fact; the same planSubmittedAt is then persisted unchanged to the submitted plan revision
start.idempotency: tenant + CUTOVER_APPROVAL_START + taskId + planRevisionId + idempotencyKey; canonical command digest includes planSubmittedAt; same key and canonical command returns REPLAYED, different canonical command is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
start.previousRule: null for initial submission; a replacement may reference exactly one same-task prior REJECTED or PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED instance. The new PENDING instance and prior replacementApprovalInstanceId are written atomically; the prior status and history are not overwritten

lockAndRevalidate.transaction: MANDATORY; locks the approval instance and compares every ExpectedCutoverApprovalFact field

resultUnion.STALE: currentFact required and differs from expected

pauseForSourceInvalidation.transaction: MANDATORY; PENDING -> PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED only while F-CUT-004 atomically invalidates the same plan revision and moves the task P5/APPROVING -> P4/PLAN_DRAFTING
pauseForSourceInvalidation.idempotency: same key/payload returns original paused fact; different payload conflicts

taskTransitions.start: F-CUT-004 owns P4/PLAN_DRAFTING -> P5/APPROVING after start returns STARTED or REPLAYED in the same transaction
taskTransitions.reject: F-CUT-005 final reject owns P5/APPROVING -> P4/PLAN_DRAFTING and appends P5_APPROVAL_REJECTED history
taskTransitions.approve: F-CUT-005 all-nodes-approved owns P5/APPROVING -> P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS and appends P5_APPROVAL_APPROVED history
taskTransitions.pause: F-CUT-005 changes only its approval fact; F-CUT-004 owns the same-transaction task P5 -> P4 change and P5_SOURCE_INVALIDATED history; PAUSED_SOURCE_INVALIDATED is terminal for that invalidated plan revision

sourceInvalidationRecovery: F-CUT-004 creates a replacement DRAFT from the invalidated revision and calls start with previousApprovalInstanceId after the replacement is submitted; start atomically links replacementApprovalInstanceId on the paused fact. The invalidated revision and paused approval never return to SUBMITTED/PENDING and are never overwritten
productionBoundary: contract only; F-CUT-004 may use src/test controlled implementation. No production Provider, Fake, fallback, approval node, todo or notification is authorized by this Gate
